findings.problem: Lu Zhi’s early career and some Wei/Jin office spans use Western intervals or bounds not stated in the cited sentences (Guo Si/Guo Huai/Liang–Yong campaigns, Ming petition window, undated recommendations, Yang Hu service span).
findings.action: Research each item against Wei/Jin annals or accept undated attestation only; do not certify blanket biography-span hints.
